question: Which Indian dance form has the Mahari dance style?
solution: The correct answer is __**Odissi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • Odissi is one of the classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha. • Mahari dance style is a traditional Odissi dance performed by the Devadasis (temple dancers) in the Jagannath temple. • This dance form is known for its fluid movements and intricate footwork, combined with expressive facial expressions. • Odissi is characterized by its sculpturesque poses, which are often inspired by the temple sculptures in Odisha.
